search.query: index=main sourcetype=soc:wazuh:alert | stats count by rule_id rule_level rule_description | sort - count
index=main sourcetype=soc:wazuh:alert | timechart span=30m count by rule_id

index=main sourcetype=soc:wazuh:alert | spath input=_raw path=source output=event_source | eval event_source=coalesce(event_source,"endpoint") | eval lab_text=lower(coalesce(event_id,"")." ".coalesce(message,"")." ".coalesce(script_block,"")) | where rule_level>=12 AND NOT match(lab_text,"synthetic|selftest|correlation|lab[-_ ]|watcher[-_ ]test|live[-_]bridge") | eval event_key=if(isnull(event_id) OR event_id="",alert_key,event_id) | dedup event_key | eval script_preview=if(len(script_block)>240,substr(script_block,1,240)."...",script_block) | sort - _time | table _time timestamp event_source event_id event_type outcome severity message agent agent_id rule_id rule_level rule_description image script_preview
